speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain for three weeks. To better understand your condition, are you currently attending school or participating in any physical activities?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

Based on your age and the combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, night pain, and recent fever, these are classic signs of leukemia. I need to confirm this with specific blood work. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential, Peripheral_Smear, and Coagulation_Panel. REQUEST IMAGES: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy_Imaging.
